messages:
jen: heads up - onboarding smoke failed for CF Workers after @redwood/sdk@1.4.3 published. error: 'TypeError: default is not a function' on import in edge handler.mjs

omar: did we switch exports to a single entry again? that pattern bites edge consumers and some bundlers.

jen: package.json shows "exports": { ".": "./dist/index.js" } and main points to dist/index.cjs. dev-only change meant to dedupe files.

tara: bundlers sometimes resolve the .js to ESM and try to call default import on a CJS module. need conditional mapping -- import vs require.

omar: workaround: pin sample-apps to 1.4.2 and add a tiny import smoke test in CI: `node -e "import('@redwood/sdk').then(m=>console.log(typeof m.default))"`

jen: can we patch with 1.4.4 that restores conditional exports and fixes types?

publish-bot: release-1.4.4 build queued (id b-992)

omar: also adding a pre-publish check in the SDK repo that verifies exports provide both import & require targets and that types align (esModuleInterop/exports style).

tara: i'll draft a short DX note about recommended package.json export patterns for edge runtimes and add links to known bundler quirks.

jen: thanks, folks. sample-apps re-run passed on the patched canary. going to promote once CI green.
